steps.label: Roll back
steps.sub: stop the bleeding now, investigate after

eyebrow: A real rollback, no rebuild needed
code:
kubectl rollout history deployment/storefront-api
kubectl rollout undo deployment/storefront-api
kubectl rollout undo deployment/storefront-api \
  --to-revision=14
kubectl rollout status deployment/storefront-api
caption: undo re-applies an earlier revision's exact pinned image — nothing gets rebuilt.
What was running before, and exactly when it changed — the two questions a rollback needs answered.
